title: 13th Floor
description: A first-person stealth horror game that fits in 13 kilobytes, and the overall winner of js13kGames 2024. Search a hotel floor room by room for keys while hiding from whatever is hunting you.
how_to_play: Click to start. WASD to move and the mouse to look. Press E or left-click to interact and F to toggle your flashlight. Find the keys and avoid being caught.
